title: Tiny, cute sunflower
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- stem -->
    <rect x='47' y='58' width='6' height='32' rx='3' fill='#3CB44A'/>
    <!-- leaf left -->
    <path d='M47 74 C36 68 30 72 28 80 C36 82 44 80 47 74 Z' fill='#5FD968'/>
    <!-- leaf right -->
    <path d='M53 66 C64 60 70 64 72 72 C64 74 56 72 53 66 Z' fill='#4FCB5B'/>
    <!-- petals -->
    <g fill='#FFD21E'>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(30 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(60 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(90 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(120 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(150 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(180 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(210 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(240 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(270 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(300 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='6' ry='11' transform='rotate(330 50 38)'/>
    </g>
    <!-- petal shading for separation -->
    <g fill='#FFB800' opacity='0.55'>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='3' ry='8'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='3' ry='8' transform='rotate(60 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='3' ry='8' transform='rotate(120 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='3' ry='8' transform='rotate(180 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='3' ry='8' transform='rotate(240 50 38)'/>
      <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='3' ry='8' transform='rotate(300 50 38)'/>
    </g>
    <!-- face / center -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='14' fill='#8A4B1E'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#B5652A' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- cute face -->
    <circle cx='45' cy='36' r='2.2' fill='#2E1508'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='36' r='2.2' fill='#2E1508'/>
    <path d='M46 42 Q50 46 54 42' stroke='#2E1508' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- blush -->
    <circle cx='40' cy='41' r='2.5' fill='#E46A6A' opacity='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='41' r='2.5' fill='#E46A6A' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
